_note: Dates only, no prose timing. Everything here is either a published official schedule or a date fixed by law — never an estimate, and never something I worked out from memory. The halving, the difficulty retarget and the quarterly options expiry are NOT in this file: they are derived from chain state in functions/_lib/calendar.js. Entries expire on their own, so a passed date costs nothing; a wrong date costs the whole page's credibility.

fields.at: ISO instant, UTC. Use 00:00Z when only the day is published.
fields.precision: 'day' when the date is exact, 'month' when only the month is known — a month-precision entry never renders as a day count.
fields.why: What a reader should watch, not a prediction.
fields.source: Where the date came from. Required — if there isn't one, the entry doesn't go in.
